Business Today Honors Over 150 Women Leaders at 23rd Most Powerful Women Awards

Business Today Recognizes Enterprise and Economic Growth

The 23rd edition of Business Today's Most Powerful Women Awards honored more than 150 women leaders for their contributions to enterprise and economic growth. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari presented the awards during the ceremony and addressed attendees regarding the ongoing expansion of women-led businesses across multiple sectors.

During his address, Gadkari emphasized the importance of women entrepreneurs in supporting broader national economic targets, specifically pointing to the objective of realizing a five-trillion-dollar economy. He noted that women leaders are increasingly expanding beyond traditional industries into sectors such as electronics manufacturing and global exports.

Leadership and Artificial Intelligence

India Today Group Vice Chairperson Kalli Purie spoke at the event, focusing on the positioning of women in positions of power relative to technological shifts. Purie described women in leadership as a vital investment capable of navigating the challenges posed by artificial intelligence, pointing to human traits such as emotional intelligence, intuition, and empathy as distinct advantages.

The event also featured a distinctive format of mutual recognition, with women leaders presenting honors to one another as part of a celebration centered on empowerment within the business community.
